out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked:RIBEYE, FILET, AHI TUNA ON DINNER MENU,
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. CFM HAD MENU EDITED WITH ADDED CONSUMER ADVISORY FOR RIBEYE, FILET, AND AHI TUNA ON DINNER MENU.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Inspect Deliveries
violations.observation: OBSERVED PRESENCE OF FRUIT FLIES - LOCALIZED TO BAG OF ONIONS.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. Routinely inspect incoming shipments of food and food supplies to control the presence of pests on the premises. CFM HAD EMPLOYEE INSPECT ALL ONIONS IN BAG - DISCARD SPOILED AND CLEAN AND WASH REMAINDER.

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: Due to improper operation of the hot water, mechanical warewashing machine, the thermolabel did not turn black, indicating that food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils are not being adequately sanitized. OBSERVED HOT WATER SANITIZING DISH MACHINE AT BAR AT 151F.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. CFM STATED SERVICE IS WAITING ON PART. DISH MACHINE IS CURRENTLY NOT BEING USED UNTIL IT IS REPAIRED. CFM WILL PROVIDE PROOF OF REPAIR TO EHS,

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 4 DWR REF.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. CFM PLACED EXTRA THERMOMETER IN UNIT.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED WALLS BEHIND MAIN KITCHEN DISH MACHINE WITH FOOD DEBRIS.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. CFM ASKED EMPLOYEE TO CLEAN WALLS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: lettuce at 47F, coleslaw at 45F, cut tomato at 45F in 2 DR prep.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM moved food to WIC. No TCS foods will be stored in unit until CFM repairs or replaces unit.
